_comment: TEMPLATE — NOT an importable realm fragment and NOT part of realm-export.prod.json.
Copy this block, replace every {{PLACEHOLDER}}, then create ONE client per chat client
the customer Organisation deploys, via the Admin Console or the Admin REST API
(POST /admin/realms/gallery/clients). This is ADR 0004 step 5 / ADR 0007's onboarding aid.
CONSISTENCY AID, NOT A SECURITY BOUNDARY (ADR 0004 Revision 3): the optionalClientScopes
list below does NOT gate what ends up in a token. Effective permissions come from the roles
the End User holds (realm_access.roles, populated by the always-on gallery-defaults scope) —
the prompt:* client scopes carry no mappers and filter nothing. Keeping admin:* /
prompt:moderate / prompt:publish:public OUT of the list matches documented intent but is not
technically enforced; no customer End User is ever granted those roles, so no org-deployed
client can carry them regardless of what it requests.
The gallery-audience (aud=prompt-gallery-api), realm_access.roles, sub and org_id claims all
ride on the gallery-defaults scope, which is a realm default scope and is therefore attached
automatically. It is also listed explicitly under defaultClientScopes below so this template
is self-contained and correct even if the realm defaults ever change.
Placeholders to fill:
{{CLIENT_ID}}     - stable client id, e.g. acme-copilot   (one per deployed chat client)
{{ORG_SLUG}}      - the customer Organisation's slug, e.g. acme   (label/description only)
{{REDIRECT_URIS}} - the deployment's OAuth redirect URI(s). Replace the single array entry
with one string per URI, e.g. "https://acme.example.com/oauth/callback".
{{WEB_ORIGINS}}   - CORS web origin(s) for the SPA/chat client, or [] if not browser-based.
Do NOT add a "secret" key — Keycloak generates the confidential secret on creation; retrieve
it out-of-band (Admin Console → Credentials, or GET .../clients/{id}/client-secret) and hand
it to the deployment team over a secure channel. This _comment key is ignored by Keycloak's
import/create; delete it if your tooling rejects unknown properties.
name: {{ORG_SLUG}} deployed chat client
description: Org-deployed confidential OAuth client for Organisation '{{ORG_SLUG}}'. Authorization-code + PKCE (S256). Created per ADR 0004 step 5 from keycloak/templates/org-deployed-client.json.
